map.放大器或网络的电压增益用分贝表示。: Voltage gain of an amplifier or network expressed in decibels.
map.输出/输入电压比取 20log10 得增益。: Take the 20log10 of the output/input voltage ratio to get the gain.
map.：增益 G = 20×log10(10/1) = 20 dB，即 10 倍电压放: : Gain G = 20 x log10(10/1) = 20 dB, that is 10x voltage amplification.
map.：若 vout=0.5、vin=1，则 G = 20×log10(0.5) ≈: : If vout = 0.5 and vin = 1, then G = 20 x log10(0.5), about -6.02 dB (about half voltage).
map.增益 dB 与功率 dB 一致吗？: Is gain in dB the same as power in dB?
map.在等阻抗下一致（电压平方=功率），否则需分别用 20log 与 10log。: They agree at equal impedance (voltage squared = power); otherwise use 20log and 10log respectively.
